relation_specs.definition: Target is effectively inevitable given the source event.
Target would not have happened without source; source alone need not guarantee target.

layer01.coreference: Group only mentions of the same real-world event.
layer01.recall_policy: exhaustive event mentions from verbs plus eventive nouns/nominalizations, states/changes, starts/ends, decisions, outcomes, movement, communication, participation and other broad MAVEN events; causal relevance is irrelevant at Layer 1
layer01.coreference_policy: keep singleton mention endpoints during extraction to avoid destructive under-merging; posthoc maps span to gold cluster
layer01.rescue_policy: after generative extraction, verify a source-only over-complete lexical candidate pool, then perform one final missed-event review
layer01.span_repair: repair only against visible source tokens; no gold IDs/types/relations

layer02.stage_a: strict directed causal-dependence LINK vs NONE gate
layer02.text_order: Never use mention order as causal direction.
layer02.temporal_signal: Real event-time BEFORE/OVERLAP plausibility is a candidate signal only; no gold temporal annotation is available.
layer02.closure: Do not automatically add transitive closure.
layer02.decision: first A_TO_B / B_TO_A / NONE; then verifier; then fixed-direction CAUSE/PRECONDITION/REJECT
layer02.direction: semantic event time/causal direction, never surface mention order
layer02.candidate_pool: all same/adjacent-sentence pairs plus a source-only high-recall nonlocal candidate proposal pass
layer02.precondition_prior: PRECONDITION is common; do not force balanced CAUSE/PRECONDITION output
layer02.stage_a2: independent KEEP/FLIP/REJECT verification of positive links
layer02.precision_policy: reject chronology, co-occurrence, shared topic, coreference, unsupported purpose/goal and narrative association before subtype classification

gold_policy: Gold event clusters and causal relations are loaded only after Layer 12.
